note: Video formats the office can build. The idea-scout adds and refreshes these from YouTube and Instagram; the clip-editor offers them as options and builds the one the owner picks. 'recipe' is the exact tool call. 'needs' lists anything our tools cannot do yet. "buildable" is true when the recipe works with the tools as they are; the page lists only those as styles.

formats.name: Smooth slow-motion swing
formats.looks_like: The whole swing from takeaway to finish in 2x slow motion, full body, golfer large, one small white label at the top, music in at the downswing, the crack on the strike.
seen_on: owner's examples (wgachampionships, trackmangolf), Instagram, 2026-10-20
formats.recipe: python3 tools/reel.py <clip> out/<name>/reel.mp4 --label "<a few lowercase words>" --mood hype

formats.name: Montage cut on the strike
formats.looks_like: One text line held the whole way, first swing slow, then every other swing at normal speed cut fast around the strike, the real crack as the sound, music low.
seen_on: owner's example (fairwayfilm), Instagram, 2026-10-20

formats.name: Hook line and punch-in
formats.looks_like: A hook line on the first second, the strike slowed with a punch-in, finish held. Louder, more edited; the owner found the first version too busy, so use it sparingly.
seen_on: general Reels advice, 2026 (work/research/reel-style/trends.md)
formats.recipe: python3 tools/reel.py <clip> out/<name>/reel.mp4 --style punch --hook "<under five words>" --mood hype

formats.name: Name the one move (slow motion on a signature feature)
formats.looks_like: One full swing in smooth slow motion, camera still, golfer large. One small label names the single thing to watch ('the pause at the top', 'rhythm & tempo'). No other text. Real strike sound on contact, music low. Built around one visible quirk so the viewer replays it to see it.
seen_on: Cameron Young's pause at the top: slow-motion clip embedded by Australian Golf Digest from an X post by LukeKerrDineen, 2026-03-16 (outside 90 days, no views shown)
Titleist video 'Cameron Young shares his driver secrets', September 2026 (titleist.com; views not shown)
'Ultra slow motion' swing uploads by Justin Thomas and Nelly Korda seen in YouTube search results for 'golf swing slow motion' (2026 in the titles, views and dates not readable)
formats.evidence: weak: topic is clearly active, no view counts found for this exact format
fits: a swing with something visible to point at (pause, big hip turn, late release)
formats.recipe: python3 tools/reel.py <clip> out/<name>/reel.mp4 --label "the pause at the top" --mood hype

formats.name: Biggest drive of the session (hook, strike, ball flight, distance)
formats.looks_like: Hook line in the first second ('longest drive today'), the swing at normal speed with a short slow beat on the strike, the camera or a cut follows the ball flight, a number on the end card (carry or total yards from the launch monitor or rangefinder). Real crack loud, music drops on the strike.
seen_on: Bryson DeChambeau, YouTube Short 'WORLDS LONGEST DRIVE EVER': 603K views in the week Sep 13-20 2026, 5.7M all time (GolfScout weekly Shorts chart; page now returns HTTP 410, numbers from a search snippet)
Bryson DeChambeau, 'Kobe!' clip: 110K views that week, 6.3M all time (same source)
formats.evidence: medium: one in-window number from a tracker snippet, not confirmed on YouTube
fits: a clip that shows the ball in the air
formats.recipe: python3 tools/reel.py <clip> out/<name>/reel.mp4 --style punch --hook "longest drive today" --end "287 YARDS" --mood hype
needs: Ball-flight tracer overlay: nothing in tools/ can draw the ball path, so the flight is only what the phone sees
The number on the end card is typed by hand; the owner has to give the yardage (no launch monitor data is read)

formats.name: Pure strike sound (impacts only, real audio)
formats.looks_like: Many range swings cut on the contact frame, no talking, no music or almost none, the crack of each ball as the whole soundtrack. Dead time between shots removed. Optional one short label.
seen_on: PGA Tour video of Tiger Woods hitting range shots at Torrey Pines, edited to only the moments of impact, covered by Golf.com as 'mesmerizing' (golf.com, date not confirmed, views not shown)
Substack essay 'the sounds of golf' (treyton.substack.com) by a creator who makes short ASMR-style range videos with announcers and dead time removed (date and views not shown)
formats.evidence: weak: the format and the sound-first idea are documented, no view counts found
fits: a range session with 5 to 10 swings
good strike sound on the phone mic

formats.name: Rate my swing (one slow swing and a question)
formats.looks_like: One swing in slow motion, label asks the question ('rate my swing 1 to 10' or 'what is wrong here'), nothing else. The caption invites comments. Built to get comments and sends rather than shares.
seen_on: TikTok slow-mo swing clips with short captions such as 'Rate my swing' and #slowmo (TikTok discover page for 'Big Justice golf swing slow mo', reported by search as 2.3M posts; not a reliable view measure, date not shown)
formats.evidence: weak: a pattern from a discovery page, no single video verified
fits: a swing the owner is happy to be judged on
formats.recipe: python3 tools/reel.py <clip> out/<name>/reel.mp4 --label "rate my swing 1 to 10" --mood hype

formats.name: One drill in one line (no talking)
formats.looks_like: The drill shown at real speed for one rep, then the same rep in slow motion; the label states the drill and what it fixes ('towel under the arm: stops the over the top move'). Ends on the finish.
seen_on: TikTok drill and tip captions from @priscillia_karol (power and using the ground, 8.0K and 5.0K as listed on hooked.so, labels of the figures not shown, no date)
Golf TikTok ranking by Favikon (Jan 2026, outside 90 days): Bryce Cope instructional swing and technique content, Grant Lee short TPI drills
formats.evidence: weak: instruction posts have smaller numbers than entertainment on the pages I could read
formats.recipe: python3 tools/montage.py out/<name>/montage.mp4 <rep-real-speed> <rep-again> --label "<what it fixes>|<what to feel>" --pre 1.5 --post 1.0 --music-volume 0.2

formats.name: Before and after (swing change side by side)
formats.looks_like: Two swings of the same player, old and new, shown one after the other or side by side and synced on the strike, label 'before' then 'after' or 'week 1 / week 8'. Slow motion on both.
seen_on: Instructor before and after swing videos (RotarySwing, Top Speed Golf), no views or dates readable
V1 Sports side-by-side swing comparison feature, synced at any frame (swing-analysis.v1sports.com)
A disc golf amateur vs professional throw comparison on Snapchat described as about 2.2M views, date not confirmed, not golf
formats.evidence: weak: no verified 2026 golf example with views
fits: two clips of the same swing weeks apart
a swing change the owner is working on
formats.recipe: python3 tools/montage.py out/montage-<date>/before-after.mp4 <old-clip> <new-clip> --label "week 1, then week 8" --mood chill
needs: Side-by-side split screen with both swings synced on the strike (a tools/compare.py)

formats.name: Range challenge with a running score
formats.looks_like: A simple challenge set up in the first second ('5 balls, hit the flag'), each attempt cut on the strike with the ball landing, a counter in the corner (1/5, 2/5...), the result held at the end. Head-to-head or against the clock if two people play.
seen_on: Max and Harry Golf, TikTok, 'Golf Ball Vs' series of short head-to-head challenges and stunts (Favikon Jan 2026 ranking, views not shown, outside 90 days)
Bryson DeChambeau, 'Can I Break 50 with Bob Does Sports? (Explosive)': 403.8K and 17.9K as listed on hooked.so (labels of the two figures not shown, no date)
Jennifer Friday, short head-to-head golf stunts on TikTok and Instagram (search summary of a creator profile page, no views)
formats.evidence: medium for the format on creator pages, weak for our size of account
fits: a target game on the range
formats.recipe: python3 tools/montage.py out/<name>/montage.mp4 <shot1> <shot2> ... --label "<the challenge in a few words>" --counter --end-card "<made> of <tries>" --music-volume 0.25

formats.name: 'Turns out' golf fact explainer (text over footage)
formats.looks_like: A question or reveal line in the first second ('why do golfers fix the grass?'), two or three short text steps over range or course footage, a closing line. Mostly fed by text and b-roll, not by a swing. Seen with Indonesian titles; the structure works in English.
seen_on: @yukiverse, YouTube Short 'Ternyata Begini Aturan Golf yang Wajib Dipatuhi Semua Pemain': 11.8M and 1.1M as listed on hooked.so (labels not shown, no date)
@luntaw, YouTube Short, prank-style 'Pegolf Ini Pura-Pura Menemukan Bolanya': 14.0M and 1.3M (same page)
@ladangcuan, 'Ternyata Merawat Lapangan Golf Serumit Ini': 1.9M and 151.6K (same page)
@fwz, 'Kenapa Pemain Golf Selalu Memperbaiki Rumput Setelah Memukul?': 180.4K and 30.4K (same page)
formats.evidence: medium for reach (largest numbers I found) but undated and from a third-party page; low fit for a swing account
fits: range footage with a topic (divots, etiquette, ball flight)
a short fact the owner knows
formats.recipe: python3 tools/cut.py <clip> out/<name>/cut.mp4 --frame crop --max 25 (closest; text steps cannot be added yet) then python3 tools/music.py out/<name>/cut.mp4 out/<name>/final.mp4 --mood chill
needs: Timed text overlay tool: a sequence of short lines with start and end times over any clip (tools/text.py)
The clip-editor would need a script of the lines from the owner

formats.name: Mock post-round interview (putter as microphone)
formats.looks_like: A friend holds a putter like a microphone and interviews the golfer in a car trunk, a parking lot or a boat, with props and gags. Under a minute. Filmed on a phone and posted from team accounts.
seen_on: High school golf teams in Central Massachusetts, Instagram team accounts, filmed Sep 16 to Oct 13 2026, 'latest rage' per Golfweek/USA TODAY article published 2026-10-15 via Yahoo Sports; one example is 51 seconds; no views given
formats.evidence: in window and on Instagram, but no view counts; needs talking and a second person, so it does not fit a silent solo account
fits: only if Aarav decides to talk on camera with a friend
not for a silent swing clip
formats.recipe: python3 tools/cut.py <clip> out/<name>/cut.mp4 --max 45 && python3 tools/captions.py out/<name>/cut.mp4 out/<name>/edit.mp4 && python3 tools/music.py out/<name>/edit.mp4 out/<name>/final.mp4 --mood funny
